definitions.explanation: A sensation of unease and discomfort in the stomach with an urge to vomit.

examples.english: I started feeling nauseous when I got on the boat.

examples.japanese: {吐|は}き{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|た}べられない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: The nausea is so bad that I can't eat anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{吐|は}き{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I feel nauseous as a side effect of the medication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{吐|は}き{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなくて→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't stop feeling nauseous since morning, so I decided to take the day off work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妊娠|にんしん}→妊娠：12227_ninshin⟧⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦つわり→つわり：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{吐|は}き{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べても→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}く→気持ち悪い：07154_kimochiwarui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In early pregnancy, the morning sickness caused severe nausea, and I felt sick no matter what I ate.

notes:
{吐|は}き{気|け} refers to the feeling of nausea. It comes from ⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ (to vomit) + {気|け} (feeling/tendency).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {吐|は}き{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel nauseous
- {吐|は}き{気|け}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{催|もよお}す→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧: to feel the urge to vomit
- {吐|は}き{気|け}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to suppress nausea
- {吐|は}き{気|け}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to stop nausea
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{吐|は}き{気|け}: severe nausea

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{乗|の}り{物|もの}{酔|よ}い→乗り物酔い：25234_norimonoyoi⟧: motion sickness
- ⟦つわり→つわり：noentry⟧: morning sickness
- ⟦{食|しょく}あたり→食あたり：08422_shokuatari⟧: food poisoning
- ⟦{二日酔|ふつかよ}い→二日酔い：08331_futsukayoi⟧: hangover
- ⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧: medication side effects

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: to vomit
- ⟦{嘔吐|おうと}→嘔吐：08446_outo⟧: vomiting (medical term)
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い→気持ち悪い：07154_kimochiwarui⟧: feeling sick/unwell
